title: jasminum fragrans
intro: Jasminum fragrans, commonly known as the night-blooming jasmine or star jasmine, is a fragrant flowering plant native to India and Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help reduce stress, anxiety, and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum fragrans include its anxiolytic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health issues.
